mapper.select: select n.notification_id as notificationId, n.category, n.title, n.message, n.target_type as targetType, n.target_id as targetId, n.created_at as createdAt, nr.is_read as isRead, nr.read_at as readAt from notification n join notification_receiver nr on n.notification_id = nr.notification_id where nr.account_id = #{value} order by n.created_at DESC
select count(notification_id) from notification_receiver where account_id=#{value}
select count(notification_id) from notification_receiver where account_id=#{value} and is_read = FALSE
select count(nr.notification_id) from notification_receiver nr join notification n on nr.notification_id = n.notification_id where nr.account_id=#{accountId} and DATE(n.created_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.update: update notification_receiver set is_read = TRUE, read_at = NOW() where account_id = #{accountId} and notification_id = #{notificationId}
update notification_receiver set is_read = TRUE, read_at = NOW() where account_id = #{value} and is_read = FALSE
mapper.delete: delete from notification_receiver where account_id = #{accountId} and notification_id = #{notificationId}
